---
name: "nf-core/fastq_create_umi_consensus_fgbio"
description: "This workflow uses the suite FGBIO to identify and remove UMI tags from\
  \ FASTQ reads\nconvert them to unmapped BAM file, map them to the reference genome,\n\
  and finally use the mapped information to group UMIs and generate consensus reads\
  \ in each group\n"
keywords:
- "fgbio"
- "umi"
- "samblaster"
- "samtools"
- "bwa"
components:
- "bwa/index"
- "bwa/mem"
- "bwamem2/mem"
- "bwamem2/index"
- "fgbio/fastqtobam"
- "fgbio/groupreadsbyumi"
- "fgbio/callmolecularconsensusreads"
- "fgbio/callduplexconsensusreads"
- "fgbio/filterconsensusreads"
- "samblaster"
- "samtools/bam2fq"
- "samtools/sort"
- "samtools/index"
- "samtools/fastq"
- "fgbio/zipperbams"
input:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of umi-tagged reads.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq.gz,fq.gz}"
- fasta_fai_dict:
    type: "file"
    description: "The reference fasta file, index and dictionary.\n\nStructure: [\
      \ val(meta), path(fasta), path(fai), path(dict) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna,fai,dict}"
- bwa_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "The reference genome bwa index files.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(index) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{amb,ann,bwt,pac,sa}"
- groupreadsbyumi_strategy:
    type: "string"
    description: "Defines the UMI assignment strategy."
    Required argument: "defines the UMI assignment strategy."
    enum:
    - "Identity"
    - "Edit"
    - "Adjacency"
    - "Paired"
- aligner:
    type: "string"
    description: "The aligner to use for mapping the reads to the reference genome.\
      \ Options are bwa-mem and bwamem2."
    enum:
    - "bwa-mem"
    - "bwamem2"
- duplex:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether the library contains duplex UMIs."
- min_reads:
    type: "integer"
    description: "One integer (for non-duplex) or a string of up-to three space-separated\
      \ numbers for duplex sequencing"
- min_baseq:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Minimum base quality for bases to be considered in consensus calling."
- max_base_error_rate:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Maximum base error rate for consensus building"
output:
- ubam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Unmapped bam file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- groupbam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Mapped bam file, where reads are grouped by UMI tag.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- consensusbam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Mapped bam file, where reads are created as consensus of those\n\
      belonging to the same UMI group.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- mappedconsensusbam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Mapped bam file, where reads are created as consensus of those\n\
      belonging to the same UMI group and filtered for minimum base quality and maximum\
      \ error rate.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
authors:
- "@lescai"
maintainers:
- "@lescai"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bwamem2/index@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwamem2/mem@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwa/index@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwa/mem@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/fgbio/callduplexconsensusreads@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/fgbio/callmolecularconsensusreads@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/fgbio/fastqtobam@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/fgbio/filterconsensusreads@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/fgbio/groupreadsbyumi@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/fgbio/zipperbams@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/samtools/fastq@0.0.0-1b655c6"
  - "nf-core/samtools/sort@0.0.0-1b655c6"

nextflow_workflow {

    name "Test Subworkflow FASTQ_CREATE_UMI_CONSENSUS_FGBIO"
    script "../main.nf"
    workflow "FASTQ_CREATE_UMI_CONSENSUS_FGBIO"

    tag "bwa"
    tag "bwa/index"
    tag "bwa/mem"
    tag "bwamem2"
    tag "bwamem2/index"
    tag "bwamem2/mem"
    tag "fgbio"
    tag "fgbio/callduplexconsensusreads"
    tag "fgbio/callmolecularconsensusreads"
    tag "fgbio/fastqtobam"
    tag "fgbio/filterconsensusreads"
    tag "fgbio/groupreadsbyumi"
    tag "fgbio/zipperbams"
    tag "samtools"
    tag "samtools/fastq"
    tag "samtools/index"
    tag "samtools/sort"
    tag "subworkflows"
    tag "subworkflows/fastq_create_umi_consensus_fgbio"
    tag "subworkflows_nfcore"

    test("single_umi") {

        config './nextflow.config'
        when {
            params {
                fastqtobam_args        = "--read-structures +T 12M11S+T"
                fastqtobam_prefix      = "test_single_unaligned"
                bam2fastq_pre_args     = "-N"
                zipperbams_pre_args    = "--compression 1"
                zipperbams_pre_prefix  = "test_single_zipped"
                bamfilter_args         = "-f 1 --output-fmt bam"
                zipperbams_post_args   = "--compression 0"
                zipperbams_post_args2  = "--tags-to-reverse Consensus --tags-to-revcomp Consensus"
                zipperbams_post_prefix = "test_single_zipped"
            }
            workflow {
                """
                input[0] = Channel.value([
                    [ id:'test_single', single_end:false ], // meta map
                    [
                        file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/fastq/test.umi_1.fastq.gz', checkIfExists: true),
                        file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/fastq/test.umi_2.fastq.gz', checkIfExists: true),
                    ]
                ])
                input[1] = Channel.value([
                    [ id:'genome' ],
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.fasta', checkIfExists: true),
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.fasta.fai', checkIfExists: true),
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.dict', checkIfExists: true)
                ])
                input[2] = false
                input[3] = "Adjacency"
                input[4] = "bwa-mem"
                input[5] = false
                input[6] = 1
                input[7] = 20
                input[8] = 0.5
                """
            }
        }

        then {
            assert workflow.success
            assert snapshot(sanitizeOutput(workflow.out)).match()
        }
    }

    test("duplex_umi") {

        config './nextflow.config'
        when {
            params {
                fastqtobam_args        = "--read-structures 38S2M1S+T 2M34S+T"
                fastqtobam_prefix      = "test_single_unaligned"
                bam2fastq_pre_args     = "-N"
                zipperbams_pre_args    = "--compression 1"
                zipperbams_pre_prefix  = "test_single_zipped"
                bamfilter_args         = "-f 1 --output-fmt bam"
                zipperbams_post_args   = "--compression 0"
                zipperbams_post_args2  = "--tags-to-reverse Consensus --tags-to-revcomp Consensus"
                zipperbams_post_prefix = "test_single_zipped"
            }
            workflow {
                """
                input[0] = Channel.value([
                    [ id:'test_single', single_end:false ], // meta map
                    [
                        file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/fastq/test_duplex_umi_1.fastq.gz', checkIfExists: true),
                        file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/fastq/test_duplex_umi_2.fastq.gz', checkIfExists: true),
                    ]
                ])
                input[1] = Channel.value([
                    [ id:'genome' ],
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.fasta', checkIfExists: true),
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.fasta.fai', checkIfExists: true),
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.dict', checkIfExists: true)
                ])
                input[2] = false
                input[3] = "Adjacency"
                input[4] = "bwa-mem"
                input[5] = false
                input[6] = 1
                input[7] = 20
                input[8] = 0.5
                """
            }
        }

        then {
            assert workflow.success
            assert snapshot(sanitizeOutput(workflow.out)).match()
        }
    }

    test("single_umi - stub") {

        options "-stub"
        config './nextflow.config'
        when {
            params {
                fastqtobam_args        = "--read-structures +T 12M11S+T"
                fastqtobam_prefix      = "test_single_unaligned"
                bam2fastq_pre_args     = "-N"
                zipperbams_pre_args    = "--compression 1"
                zipperbams_pre_prefix  = "test_single_zipped"
                bamfilter_args         = "-f 1 --output-fmt bam"
                zipperbams_post_args   = "--compression 0"
                zipperbams_post_args2  = "--tags-to-reverse Consensus --tags-to-revcomp Consensus"
                zipperbams_post_prefix = "test_single_zipped"
            }
            workflow {
                """
                input[0] = Channel.value([
                    [ id:'test_single', single_end:false ], // meta map
                    [
                        file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/fastq/test.umi_1.fastq.gz', checkIfExists: true),
                        file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/fastq/test.umi_2.fastq.gz', checkIfExists: true),
                    ]
                ])
                input[1] = Channel.value([
                    [ id:'genome' ],
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.fasta', checkIfExists: true),
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.fasta.fai', checkIfExists: true),
                    file(params.modules_testdata_base_path + 'genomics/homo_sapiens/genome/genome.dict', checkIfExists: true)
                ])
                input[2] = false
                input[3] = "Adjacency"
                input[4] = "bwa-mem"
                input[5] = false
                input[6] = 1
                input[7] = 20
                input[8] = 0.5
                """
            }
        }

        then {
            assertAll(
                { assert workflow.success},
                { assert snapshot(sanitizeOutput(workflow.out)).match()}
            )
        }
    }
}
